text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Katsuragi Ace takes the lead!! The 
chasers are closing in!!

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: I'll overtake on the straight...!!

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Don't misjudge the moment to strike...! 
Just a little more, just a bit longer...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —I won't let you get away...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Rounding the 4th corner!! Now onto the 
straight!! The all-important 
straightaway!!

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusumes
text_block_list.text: Right here!!!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I'll catch you—!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Haha—!!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ――WOOOOAAAAAHHHH!!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Katsuragi Ace is holding on!! Katsuragi 
Ace is holding her ground!!

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Kh, you've gotta be kidding me...!?

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: I can't... reach them...!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...She's smiling—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa―― You're amazing, Ace...! It's 
just like――

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
It feels like soaring through the 
heavens...!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Katsuragi Ace goes wire-to-wire across 
the finish line!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (...Ooooooooooooh!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOH!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
She did it she did it she did it she did 
it—!! S-cchi won!! She wooooon—!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Yes!! She did it!! The first 
Japanese Umamusume to win the Japan Cup!! 
Ace-chan did it!!!

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
You really are... someone who will just 
keep pressing forward forever, aren't 
you...? Congratulations, Ace-san—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOH!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I really... actually won, didn't I... I 
see... I won...!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Hell yeahhhhhhhhhhh!!!!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: —Today was my complete defeat.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
That was the greatest race. Thank you, 
Ace.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —Yeah. That truly was a magnificent run.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Rudolf...—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The sight of you that was burned into my 
eyes today... I will never, for the rest 
of my life, forget that brilliant, radiant 
run.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The potential held by Umamusume... I feel 
as though I've caught a glimpse of one of 
its pinnacles.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—And now, as one who aims for the 
pinnacle, I have a request to make of you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Katsuragi Ace. Would you do me the honor 
of competing against me once more?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—The stage where dreams gather: the Arima 
Kinen. I want to challenge you once again 
at that Grand Prix.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Hey, how come you didn't invite me?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I had thought it would simply manifest 
itself without needing to be spoken of, 
however.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Surely, you don't intend to let it end 
like this either, right?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...Of course. I'll take down both Ace and 
Rudolf together at the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: And so— Let's do it, Ace. The Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Bring it on...! I won't lose at the Arima 
Kinen either!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Alright. Now that the next one's decided—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Let us praise Japan's proud 
representative— our very own "Ace."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mr. C.B. and Symboli Rudolf gesture toward 
the winner, Katsuragi Ace, presenting her 
to the crowd in the stands.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The roaring cheers praising Katsuragi Ace 
echoed long and loud, continuing to shake 
Tokyo Racecourse—

text_block_list.name: Man Who Loves Racing
text_block_list.text:
――Haha, to think even our "Prince" would 
lose! What a wild race that was!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa...! What the heck 
was that race...!! What on earth is with 
this Umamusume...?!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
There's an incredible monster out 
there...! I can't just sit around like 
this...!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
This is where I'm aiming for! This is 
where the romance lies!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And then, a few days after the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
With the upcoming Arima Kinen, fans are 
calling you, Symboli Rudolf, and Mr. C.B. 
the "Big Three." What are your thoughts on 
this?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, the 'Big Three', huh! Sounds pretty 
good to me!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Still—I'm number one. I'll prove it at the 
Arima Kinen!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Ooooh...!)

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Following your brilliant victory in the 
recent Japan Cup, some overseas are 
hailing you as the 'Ace of Japan.' How do 
you feel about that?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Ace of Japan! For real?! I'm so 
ridiculously happy...!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Still, if they're going to call me 
"Japan's Ace"—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: My Trainer is truly '<username> of the World'!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
With Japan's Ace and the world's <username>, we'll 
definitely take the Arima Kinen!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Please look forward to our race!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The final showdown of the year, the 
"Arima Kinen," is right around the 
corner...!
